subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code so that the project asks the user questions and shares their responses!

validationItems.text: switch name and place variable locations
validationItems.failureText: Make sure the variables are called in the right order in the (join) block.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 3 of Orange Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about user input, variables, and arrays. A variable stores one piece of information, while an array stores multiple pieces of information, of the same data type, in an ordered list. Variables and arrays can take in information while they are being created, while the program is running, and from user input. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 3:

badges.title: Save the Data
badges.description: Create variables and arrays to store and use data in a project.

badges.title: Results May Vary
badges.description: Create a new variable and assign it a value.

badges.title: Making a List
badges.description: Create and add items to an array.

badges.title: Dictionary
badges.description: Create and use an array of strings.

badges.title: Art Critic
badges.description: Compare two images to make something happen in a project.
